statements.text: The Vigilance & Enforcement wing issued a report regarding suspected cartelisation in drain works contracts in three Urban Local Bodies from 2023 to 2025.
statements.quote: Report of the Vigilance & Enforcement wing on suspected cartelisation in drain works

statements.text: The wing conducted a confidential analysis of 46 drain works contracts.
statements.quote: The Vigilance & Enforcement wing undertook a confidential analysis of 46 drain works

statements.text: The analysis showed that the lowest bid was within 0.5% of the estimate in 27 cases, which indicates possible bid rotation.
statements.quote: 0.5% of the estimate in 27 cases, indicating possible bid rotation.
